summary: Hello Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of COO Sichuan Zhang, effective July 31, 2026, for personal reasons. Zhang will remain a board member. The resignation was not due to any dispute or disagreement with the Company. The filing identifies the departure as voluntary and unrelated to operational or policy matters, but the abrupt exit of a C-suite officer constitutes a management change event. The Company's CFO signed the report. Watch for any subsequent operational or strategic adjustments and announcements regarding a successor COO.
